title: Let simran cool the body from within
summary: This passage does not treat worry as only mental; it says remembrance dispels anguish from the body. Naam is allowed to reach the chest, shoulders, and breath where fear has settled.
takeaway: Let Naam reach the body where worry lodged.
lifeApplication: When anxiety becomes physical, do not argue with the body first. Repeat the Name slowly enough for the breath, shoulders, and stomach to receive what the mind cannot force.

source.shortMeaning: Remembrance dispels worry and anguish from the body, not only from thought.
source.lifeApplication: When anxiety becomes physical, let the Name cool the places where fear has lodged.

evidence.coreClaim: Remembrance dispels worry and anguish from the body, not only from thought.
evidence.turn: Let simran enter the body where worry has been living.
evidence.practicalImplication: When anxiety becomes physical, do not argue with the body first. Repeat the Name slowly enough for the breath, shoulders, and stomach to receive what the mind cannot force.
